serverInfo.name: medgpt-server
serverInfo.description: MedGPT Model Context Protocol server for medical report analysis, lab result interpretation, and health information lookup.

tools.name: analyze_blood_test
tools.description: Analyze blood test biomarkers against standard clinical reference ranges and provide plain-English explanations.

name.description: Biomarker name, e.g., Hemoglobin, Fasting Blood Glucose, TSH, eGFR

unit.description: Measurement unit, e.g., mg/dL, g/dL, mIU/L

tools.name: lookup_medication
tools.description: Look up comprehensive medication details including dosage guidelines, indications, contraindications, and drug interactions.

medicationName.description: Generic or brand name of medication, e.g., Metformin, Lisinopril, Amoxicillin

tools.name: explain_medical_term
tools.description: Translate complex medical jargon or clinical diagnoses into clear, patient-friendly explanations.

term.description: Medical terminology or diagnostic phrase, e.g., Thrombocytopenia, Dyslipidemia, Hepatomegaly
